# CNN

> > CNN is a global news organization delivering breaking news, live updates, and in-depth coverage across U.S., world, politics, health, and entertainment, with CNN Academy providing professional journalism training worldwide.

CNN combines 24-hour news coverage with multimedia storytelling and investigative reporting. CNN Academy offers journalism education programs in locations including Dublin, Abu Dhabi, Hong Kong, and Kuala Lumpur, focusing on AI journalism, mobile journalism, and digital storytelling techniques.

## Key Topics

- Breaking news and live updates
- International affairs and world reporting
- Journalism training and education
- Multimedia storytelling
- AI journalism and mobile journalism
- Health and infectious disease coverage
- Political coverage and current events
- CNN Academy programs (Dublin, Abu Dhabi, Hong Kong, Kuala Lumpur)
- Dr. Sanjay Gupta health reporting
- LumaFusion mobile video editing
- Newsroom simulation training
- Climate storytelling
- Entertainment and celebrity news
- Masters programs and summer institutes

## Core News & Homepage

- [Breaking News, Latest News and Videos | CNN](https://us.cnn.com/): CNN homepage with breaking news on U.S., world, politics, and entertainment

## CNN Academy - Journalism Education

- [CNN Academy – Homepage](http://academy.cnn.com/): CNN Academy homepage for journalism education and training programs
- [Courses - CNN Academy](https://academy.cnn.com/courses/): CNN Academy course catalog for journalism training worldwide

## News Coverage & Reports

- [CNN.com - World Report: Main Page](https://us.cnn.com/WORLD/world.report/): CNN World Report featuring international human interest stories
- [Health News - Infectious Disease News and Information from CNN health](https://us.cnn.com/HEALTH/conditions/infectious.diseases/): CNN Health section covering infectious diseases, vaccines, and prevention
- [Show Pages - Showbiz Tonight - CNN.com](https://us.cnn.com/CNN/Programs/showbiz.tonight/): Showbiz Tonight entertainment news with A.J. Hammer and celebrity coverage
